messages:
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Hey team, passing off the new client 'Aster Labs' — signed yesterday. Quick context: pilot will start next Mon (3-week runway). They chose Dedicated + SSO, will also test private VPC later. Renewal flagged: likely enterprise after pilot but CFO concerned about token costs. Need CS to own onboarding and ops, and Support/Eng loop for SSO + VPC networking.
Diego Ramos (CS Manager): Thanks Maya. Can you drop the key contacts + any pre-provisioned infra details?
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Yep — contacts: Elena (CTO) elena@asterlabs.io, Raj (Cloud Eng) raj@asterlabs.io. We pre-provisioned 2 g4dn nodes for Dedicated trial (billing code: ACCT-9831). SSO: they want Okta OIDC; provided metadata already to Priya.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): Noted. I'll create the onboarding runbook and assign owners. Major risks we should track: SSO failure, capacity throughput spikes, and cost surprises from burst traffic.
Priya Patel (Solutions Eng): I have the Okta metadata, will validate tomorrow. Quick question — are they planning long prompts (>8k)? That affects model choice/throughput.
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Elena said most calls are ~1k tokens but a few long-batch reranks could be 12k. They want fallback to a 8k-optimized variant if latency spikes.
Liam O'Connor (Support Eng): Copy. I'll open an infra ticket to reserve headroom and set up autoscale policy: min=2, burst to 6 for pilot. Ticket: SPT-4412.
oncall-bot: Incident SPT-4412 created by Liam.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): Action list I'm proposing: 1) Priya validate Okta + provide test plan (owner: Priya, due: +48h). 2) Liam set autoscale & reserve capacity, and add canary traffic ramp (owner: Liam, due: +72h). 3) Diego schedule kickoff + weekly syncs (owner: Diego, due: today). 4) CS to capture cost baseline and alert thresholds (owner: Tara, due: before pilot). 5) Create escalation path to Eng for quant/regression (owner: Diego).
Diego Ramos (CS Manager): Adding renewal risk notes: CFO's concern = high. We'll instrument token burn dashboard and set early-warning at 30% over forecast. Also include a cost-optimization consult during week 2 (quantization, batching).
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): I'll share their expected query volume (avg qps ~4, peak 12) and projected 3-month spend in the handoff doc.
Priya Patel (Solutions Eng): For SSO tests I'll need a dev account from Raj with Okta test app + a test user. Raj, can you provision?
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Raj confirmed in email — test account will be ready by tomorrow EOD.
Liam O'Connor (Support Eng): Two open engineering asks I flagged: a) KV cache eviction tuning for long-batch flows; b) fallback routing to 8k-optimized variant on latency > 450ms. I'll link to SPT-4412 with subtasks.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): I'll create the onboarding checklist in Confluence and link to SPT-4412 + COST-ALARM board. Will also add a feedback capture form for Elena's team after week 1.
Diego Ramos (CS Manager): Who will be primary POC for day-to-day CS?
Tara Singh (CS Ops): I'll take primary POC for onboarding (Tara), Diego will be escalation and renewal lead.
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Thanks — please ping me if we need to prep any docs for procurement.
Priya Patel (Solutions Eng): Plan for SSO validation: 1) metadata import 2) test sign-in 3) token mapping verification 4) test user flows (owner: Priya). Will post results here.
Liam O'Connor (Support Eng): ETA for autoscale + canary config is 36h. I'll also include tracing hooks so we can attribute latency to model variant or infra.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): Final checklist to confirm before kick: - Okta validated ✅? - Autoscale configured ✅? - Canary ramp script committed ✅? - Cost baseline dashboard created ✅? If any of these are No, hold kickoff.
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Sounds good. Quick FYI — they want an intro doc for their SREs on how Redwood handles KV caching and fallback logic. Priya/Liam can we draft a 1-pager?
Priya Patel (Solutions Eng): Yes, drafting 1-pager and will share tomorrow.
Liam O'Connor (Support Eng): I'll add a short troubleshooting playbook (common SSO failures, cache ops) and link it to Confluence.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): I'll convert the thread into the onboarding ticket and assign owners now. Expect Confluence link in 2 hours.
Diego Ramos (CS Manager): Great. Thanks everyone. We'll do daily check-ins for first 3 days of pilot.
Maya Chen (AM - Sales): Appreciate it. Leaving notes in handoff doc for renewal angle (schedule 1:1 with CFO in week 2).
Priya Patel (Solutions Eng): Done — posted SSO test plan and initial findings.
Liam O'Connor (Support Eng): SPT-4412 updated with autoscale + subtasks. Canary script in repo: infra/canaries/asterlabs-ramp.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): Confluence onboarding runbook created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/ASTER-ONBOARDING. Assignments set.
Diego Ramos (CS Manager): Last note — capture customer feedback: Tara, add short NPS check + two qualitative questions after week 1.
Tara Singh (CS Ops): Will do. Closing the handoff here — ping me for any blockers. :wave:
